Seats (VERA/ARGUS/CATO) write the attach_status confirmation field INTO the verdict .md body AFTER the sha round-trip + bw attach, to record the attach outcome. That post-hash body mutation means: the as-attached/attested copy (what the seat cites + bw stores) carries attach_status blank; the later in-tree committed copy carries attach_status: OK. If the arc TRACKS the verdict in-tree (the new pattern), the committed verdict diverges from the cited sha by exactly that field. save-verdict.md clause (d) ALREADY says attach_status belongs in the seat DISPATCH RETURN, not the verdict body -- so the seats contradict clause (d).
